def compress(grid):
    """The grid without its frontiers: every row and every column that is one color throughout."""
    rows = {i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1}
    cols = {j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if len({row[j] for row in grid}) == 1}
    return [[v for j, v in enumerate(row) if j not in cols] for i, row in enumerate(grid) if i not in rows]

def upscale(grid, factor):
    """Each cell as a factor x factor block of its color."""
    return [[v for v in row for _ in range(factor)] for row in grid for _ in range(factor)]

def crop(grid, top, left, height, width):
    """The height x width subgrid whose top-left cell is (top, left)."""
    return [row[left:left + width] for row in grid[top:top + height]]

def trim(grid):
    """The grid without its outermost rows and columns."""
    return [row[1:-1] for row in grid[1:-1]]

def replace(grid, old, new):
    """The grid with every cell of color old recolored new."""
    return [[new if v == old else v for v in row] for row in grid]

def hperiod(grid):
    """The smallest p such that every row repeats itself every p cells: the grid's width if none is smaller."""
    w = len(grid[0])
    return next(p for p in range(1, w + 1) if all(row[j] == row[j - p] for row in grid for j in range(p, w)))

def regions(mask):
    h,w=len(mask),len(mask[0]); seen=set(); out=[]
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if mask[i][j] and (i,j) not in seen:
                stack=[(i,j)]; seen.add((i,j)); cells=[]
                while stack:
                    y,x=stack.pop(); cells.append((y,x))
                    for dy,dx in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
                        if 0<=ny<h and 0<=nx<w and mask[ny][nx] and (ny,nx) not in seen:

                ys=[c[0] for c in cells]; xs=[c[1] for c in cells]
                t,l=min(ys),min(xs); bh,bw=max(ys)-t+1,max(xs)-l+1
                m=[[0]*bw for _ in range(bh)]
                for y,x in cells: m[y-t][x-l]=1
                out.append((t,l,m))
    return out

def transform(grid):
    # split: find the column(s) of all-zero separator
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    sep=[j for j in range(w) if all(grid[i][j]==0 for i in range(h))]
    # left panel = cols before first separator run
    s=sep[0]
    left=[row[:s] for row in grid]
    right=[[v for v in row[s:] ] for row in grid]
    border=left[0][0]
    mask=[[1 if v!=border and v!=0 else 0 for v in row] for row in left]
    holes=regions(mask)
    # shapes in right panel: nonzero colors, each color one shape
    colors=sorted({v for row in right for v in row if v})
    shapes={}
    rmask=[[1 if v else 0 for v in row] for row in right]
    # per color region
    for c in colors:
        cm=[[1 if right[i][j]==c else 0 for j in range(len(right[0]))] for i in range(h)]
        t,l,m=regions(cm)[0]
        shapes[c]=m
    out=[row[:] for row in left]
    for t,l,m in holes:
        for c,sm in shapes.items():
            if sm==m:
                for y in range(len(m)):
                    for x in range(len(m[0])):
                        if m[y][x]: out[t+y][l+x]=c
    return out
